item_short_desc: Show your support for New York City’s Police with this Officially Licensed NYPD Adjustable Cap.
description: Show your support for New York City’s Police with this Officially Licensed NYPD Adjustable Cap. The front panel of this low-profile cap reads “NYPD” in large, embroidered letters with impeccable detailing, while the word “POLICE” is sewn in white thread on both sides of this police baseball cap. Additionally, the adjustable hook and loop closure on the back of this NYPD hat also features “NYPD” text. This police department hat constructed with 100% comfortable and breathable cotton and is officially licensed by the City of New York.
